title: Aerated Herbal Croatian Brie Tart
description: A nostalgic Croatian dessert featuring brie cheese and sweet, aerated toppings. This tart is perfect for a weeknight treat.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: chilled and cut into small pieces

ingredients.name: candy pieces (such as M&M's or chopped peanut butter cups)

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour and confectioners' sugar. Add cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingertips to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Press the mixture into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom, pressing it evenly into the corners.
Bake the crust at 350°F for 15 minutes, then set aside to cool.
In a large bowl, beat the brie cheese with an electric mixer until it's smooth. Add the granulated sugar, vanilla extract, honey, and salt, and beat until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, lemon zest, and almond extract. Add this mixture to the cheese mixture and beat until smooth.
Pour the cheese mixture into the cooled tart crust and smooth the top with an offset spatula.
Bake the tart at 350°F for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is just slightly jiggly.
Remove the tart from the oven and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar. Allow it to cool to room temperature before slicing and serving.
To make the aerated topping, beat the egg whites and granulated sugar in a large bowl until stiff peaks form. Add the hazelnut oil and beat until well combined.
To assemble the tart, spread a layer of candy pieces on top of the cooled tart. Then sprinkle the aerated topping over the candy pieces.
Dust with confectioners' sugar and serve immediately.
To make the candy-studded jam topping, combine the raspberry jam and maple syrup in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Remove from heat and stir in the cocoa nibs.
Spread the jam mixture over the top of the tart, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle with additional candy pieces and confectioners' sugar, if desired.
